details: A significant security breach involving a $130 million software flaw in Coldcard hardware wallets has pushed the Crypto Fear & Greed Index to "extreme fear." While Bitcoin and Ethereum largely held steady, smaller altcoins experienced increased volatility. Users are strongly advised to move funds and promptly update their firmware.
title: Coldcard Wallet Exploit Triggers Extreme Crypto Fear

details: Bitcoin spot Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) recorded positive net inflows of $211.5 million on August 4, marking the first substantial daily inflow in weeks. However, the cumulative 30-day flow remains negative at -$1.62 billion. In contrast, Ethereum ETFs demonstrated strong, consistent institutional demand with $53.1 million in daily inflows and a positive 30-day net of +$123.7 million, suggesting a potential institutional rotation.
title: Bitcoin ETF Inflows Rebound, Ethereum ETFs See Sustained Demand

details: A dormant Bitcoin wallet, holding 16,400 BTC (valued over $1 billion), recently became active, which analysts suggest could be a custody restructuring rather than an immediate liquidation. Concurrently, Michael Saylor's social media activity has fueled speculation that MicroStrategy may resume Bitcoin purchases, signaling a potential resurgence of institutional buying interest.
title: Dormant Bitcoin Wallet Active, Saylor Hints at MicroStrategy Accumulation

details: Global financial markets are reacting positively to optimism surrounding an imminent reopening of the Strait of Hormuz and strong corporate earnings reports, driving equities to new record highs. Weaker-than-expected US job openings and factory orders are contributing to lower Treasury yields, which in turn reduces inflation expectations and the probability of further Federal Reserve interest rate hikes. These developing "looser financial conditions" are generally favorable for risk assets, including cryptocurrencies.
title: Easing Geopolitical Tensions, Weaker Jobs Data Boost Risk Sentiment

details: BNY Mellon has announced a partnership with Galaxy Digital, enabling its institutional clients to directly earn staking rewards on their cryptocurrency holdings within the bank's custody platform. This collaboration integrates proof-of-stake capabilities into BNY Mellon's Digital Asset Custody system, streamlining institutional access to crypto staking and increasing utility for digital assets.
title: BNY Mellon Partners with Galaxy Digital for Institutional Crypto Staking
